// <auto-generated />
#nullable enable
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;
using OcctSharp.Interop;
namespace OcctSharp.CopiedCollections;

/// <summary>Immutable copied one-dimensional data with native index bounds. No native storage is retained.</summary>
public sealed class CopiedArray<T> where T : unmanaged
{
    private readonly T[] _values;
    /// <summary>Copies the supplied values. Native bounds reserve both signed integer endpoints for safe kernel arithmetic.</summary>
    public CopiedArray(ReadOnlySpan<T> values, int lower = 1)
    {
        if (values.Length == 0) throw new ArgumentException("Array1 requires at least one element.", nameof(values));
        if (lower == int.MinValue || (long)lower + values.Length > int.MaxValue) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(lower));
        Lower = lower;
        _values = values.ToArray();
    }
    /// <summary>First native index.</summary>
    public int Lower { get; }
    /// <summary>Last native index.</summary>
    public int Upper => checked(Lower + (Count - 1));
    /// <summary>Number of elements.</summary>
    public int Count => _values.Length;
    /// <summary>Returns an element by native index.</summary>
    public T this[int index] => _values[checked(index - Lower)];
    /// <summary>Returns a fresh independent copy in index order.</summary>
    public T[] ToArray() => (T[])_values.Clone();
    internal ReadOnlySpan<T> Values => _values;
}

/// <summary>Immutable copied sequence; empty sequences are allowed and native indices start at one.</summary>
public sealed class CopiedSequence<T> where T : unmanaged
{
    private readonly T[] _values;
    /// <summary>Copies the supplied values.</summary>
    public CopiedSequence(ReadOnlySpan<T> values) => _values = values.ToArray();
    /// <summary>Number of elements.</summary>
    public int Count => _values.Length;
    /// <summary>Returns an element by one-based native index.</summary>
    public T this[int index] => _values[checked(index - 1)];
    /// <summary>Returns a fresh independent copy in sequence order.</summary>
    public T[] ToArray() => (T[])_values.Clone();
    internal ReadOnlySpan<T> Values => _values;
}
